announcements.title: Sky Music 4.0 Is Here
announcements.body:
We're pleased to announce a major update to Sky Music.

What's new:
•  SoundCloud support, alongside YouTube
•  Voice effects — Baby, Chipmunk, Deep, Demon, Robot, Echo
•  Playlists
•  DJ-style speed control
•  Discord Rich Presence (now playing)
•  Customizable app theme

The update installs automatically — just open Sky Music and select Yes when prompted.

Thank you for being part of Sky Music.

announcements.title: Welcome to Sky Music
announcements.body: Play any track from YouTube or SoundCloud with studio-quality reverb.\n\nWe're glad to have you on board.
